user.title: Home Structure
user.description: Home Structure describes which spaces of your home are next to each other and what separates them (open space, door, window, shutter, wall…) with the sensors that tell if it is open. Other integrations can then use it. Nothing is changed in your home. Add it, then use Configure to describe your home.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Structure is already set up.

init.title: Home Structure
init.description: 1. Choose which Home Assistant areas belong to the structure. 2. Say which ones are gardens, halls, balconies… 3. Connect the spaces that touch each other. Save when you are done.

menu_options.zones_bulk: Mark gardens, halls and other zones
menu_options.add_connection: Connect two spaces one by one

add_zone.title: Add a zone
add_zone.description: A zone is a space that is not an ordinary room. It can be inside your home (garden, balcony) or outside it (street, building hall, neighbour). If it already exists as a Home Assistant area, choose it so its devices stay where they are.

data_description.area: Leave empty for a space with no area, such as the street.

data_description.name: Optional for an existing area: it replaces the area name only in Home Structure.
data_description.in_home: Switch on for a garden or balcony that belongs to the home; off for the street, the building hall or a neighbour.

add_connection.title: Connect two spaces
add_connection.description: Choose two spaces that are next to each other, then say what separates them. A plain wall also counts: it says the spaces are adjacent.

data.add_another: Add another separation between the same two spaces

data_description.sensor: A door or window sensor, or a cover for a shutter. Not needed for an open space, an opening or a wall.

choose_spaces.title: Spaces of the structure
choose_spaces.description: Untick the areas that are not places of your home (technical groupings, for example). Unticked areas are ignored; their zones and connections are removed.

data_description.areas: Every area is ticked by default. The floor of each area is shown to help you choose.

zones_bulk.title: Gardens, halls and other zones
zones_bulk.description: Pick the areas that are not ordinary rooms, by kind. Gardens, balconies, terraces, courtyards and garages count as part of the home; halls, stairwells and shared areas do not (change this zone by zone in “Edit or remove a zone”).

data_description.street: A space with no Home Assistant area.
data_description.neighbor: A space with no Home Assistant area.

quick_connect.title: Connect spaces quickly
quick_connect.description: Choose a space, then you will pick everything that touches it.

quick_targets.title: What touches {origin}?
quick_targets.description: Already connected: {linked}. Tick every other space that touches it and say what separates them; you can refine each connection afterwards.

data_description.type: Used for all the spaces ticked here.

refine.title: Refine a connection
refine.description:
{connection}
Correct what separates them if needed, and choose the sensor that says whether it is open. Leave the sensor empty to skip. Left after this one: {left}.

data_description.sensor: Only door, window and cover entities of the two areas are listed when there are some.

error.name_required: A name is required for a zone that is not a Home Assistant area.
error.duplicate_zone_name: Another space already has this name.
error.area_already_zone: This area is already a zone.
error.sensor_not_needed: An open space, an opening and a wall have no sensor.
error.area_in_two_kinds: An area can only have one kind. Remove it from one of the lists.

abort.duplicate_zone_name: Two zones have the same name.
abort.unknown_area: A zone refers to an area that no longer exists.
abort.unknown_space: A connection refers to a space that no longer exists. Remove it and add it again.
abort.duplicate_connection: Two connections link the same spaces.
abort.sensor_not_needed: An open space, an opening and a wall have no sensor.
abort.invalid_shutter: A shutter can only be set on a door, a glass door or a window, and it must be a cover.
abort.invalid_room_type: A room type is invalid, or given to something that is not an ordinary room.

get_structure.name: Get structure
get_structure.description: Returns the spaces of the home, how they are connected and the current state of every separation.

get_groups.name: Get groups
get_groups.description: Returns the groups of rooms: their rooms (area ids), aliases and the sensors that give their temperature and humidity.
